course_name_original: Havacılık Motorları İçin Kontrol Sistemi Tasarımı (Sektör Dersi)
course_name_en: Control System Design for Aviation Engines (Sector Course)
prerequisites: System Dynamics and Control Course is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Solves differential equations in Simulink environment
Can Justify and Verify the Control System

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts, definitions, information on the achievements to be gained at the end of the course.
Stages of control system development, necessary roles and responsibilities.
System dynamics modeling techniques. Determining the level of detail required for the model, purpose-oriented modeling.
Methods for determining the physical values of model parameters, designing experiments and tests.
System response analysis: reading and interpreting generated differential equations.
Aviation-specific criteria in control system design.
Introduction to controller design, methods, objectives, requirements.
Verification stages, methods: requirement tree, traceability, analysis, test methods
Verification stages, methods: requirement tree, traceability, analysis, test methods continued.
assessment_rules: The overall assessment is determined by coursework contributions and a final exam. Coursework (Midterm Exam, Assignments, Project/Design) accounts for 60% of the grade, and the Final Exam accounts for 40%.
bibliography: Arifoğlu, U., “MATLAB ve Mühendislik Uygulamaları”, Alfa Yayınları
